name: Mary
overview: Mary is a female figure identified as the wife of Joseph and the mother of the Messiah, Jesus Christ. While her tribal affiliation and additional notes are not specified, her unique role as the mother of the Savior is central to her identity in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Mary carries various meanings including bitterness, plump one, wished-for child, and one who loves or is loved, reflecting a range of possible Hebrew interpretations. She is also known by the title 'the mother of Jesus,' directly indicating her role as the mother of Yeshua.
familyAndRelationships: Mary is married to Joseph and is the mother of Jesus, who is referred to as the Messiah. Additionally, she is identified as the mother of James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas, indicating her role as a mother to several children according to Scripture.
scriptureSignificance: Mary holds a pivotal place in the biblical narrative as the humble young woman chosen by God to bear His Son, fulfilling prophecy through her obedience and faith. Her willingness to accept God's plan exemplifies true discipleship and highlights God's work through faithful servants. As the mother of Jesus, she was present throughout His earthly ministry and witnessed key moments in His life, underscoring her integral role in salvation history.
